_about: Story gates (tools/rando/parity/story.py). Every value the plugin accepts is made in the game the way OoTR's own rules describe it; this file only holds the places where the game can't (yet) do OoTR's rule and the logic follows the game instead (always stricter than OoTR, never looser), plus the vanilla bridge's Light Arrows, which the plugin now checks in the game. Count conditions (bridge, Light Arrow cutscene) are checked in the game on the same items OoTR counts. open_forest 'fast' still has Mido check the sword and shield, which a child can show wherever OoTR's 'Showed Mido Sword & Shield' holds.

_why.can_build_rainbow_bridge: OoTR's helper with world_settings' vanilla rewrite ('Remake Light Arrow Cutscene', the remake's bridge trigger) plus OoTR's Light_Arrows: story.py's bridge() makes the vanilla bridge appear after the Light Arrow cutscene with the Light Arrows in the pouch (that cutscene gives any item in a randomizer). With the vanilla Light Arrow cutscene this is OoTR's Shadow + Spirit (boss defeats) + Light Arrows.
_why.Root / Kakariko Village Gate Open: open_kakariko 'zelda': OoTR opens the gate as soon as the letter is held, from anywhere. The remake's gate opens when the letter is shown to the guard on the Kakariko side (Npc_Hylia_Soldier_003 ShowItem_ZeldaLetter); a child arriving from Death Mountain can't. So 'zelda' keeps only the Kakariko Village event (is_child and Zeldas_Letter), as 'closed'. With Zelda's Letter at the start (skip child Zelda) the plugin opens the gate on a new file.
_why.Lake Hylia / LH Sun: Logic/HyruleField_LakeHylia_Adult_Prefab_5313 needs SubEvent_GetFireArrow past Ready, which its Challenge row only allows (DependFlag and ForceProgressGameData) once SageOfWater_IsCompleted_Exp holds: the scarecrow/longshot way OoTR allows before the Water Temple doesn't exist.
_why.can_ride_epona: no_epona_race (tools/rando/parity/_gaps_minigames.py): OoTR collects its Epona event at the start (ItemPool.py) and calls her anywhere with the song. The remake's owned horse is engine state that only Animal_Epona_Adult.EventCopyAndRegisterOwnedHorse creates, on the ranch's own Epona (HyruleField_Adult_Static, Lon Lon Ranch, present until Get_Epona is Complete): the plugin registers her when the adult plays Epona's Song next to her, so Epona needs one daytime ranch visit with the song first (OoTR's own Lon Lon Ranch Epona rule without the race). Stricter than OoTR. With no_epona_race off the setting folds away and the helper is OoTR's (Epona, the ranch event).
_why.remake_zelda_escape_ready: Zelda's escape can happen. The story plugin's fix for Impa's lesson (_story_traps.py; #1; Clawshot) makes DoorOfTime_CheckStoneNum (Event38) wait for Rando_DoorOfTime_StoneCountOpen_Exp = HavePlayedEvent.Dm_MelodyGet_Zelda (Impa's lesson, at her send-off after Zelda) OR Goto_HyruleCastle_IsCompleted_Exp (skip_child_zelda's start state); a Dodongo's Cavern / Jabu-Jabu end before that counts nothing and Impa's send-off recounts. So DoorOfTime reaches Step03 (the drawbridge escape) only after the lesson. The lesson is OoTR's Song from Impa spot (HC Garden Skippable Locations), which needs an ocarina since a lesson without one froze in game (songs_trade.json): hence is_child and Ocarina there. Not implied before: has_all_stones is the three boss defeats, none of which needs Zelda (Zelda's Lullaby can come from any song spot, Dodongo's Cavern by the Lost Woods shortcut).
_why.can_open_door_of_time: OoTR's helper with remake_zelda_escape_ready in the stones_oot_sot branch (the default door): the vanilla chain is stones -> the drawbridge escape (Step03) -> the Ocarina of Time at the moat (Step04/05) -> the Song of Time at the door (Step06, the door's isOpen), and Step03 now waits for Impa's lesson. The other door values open by the story plugin's own flags (the 'stones' flag at the third stone stage, its hook before the stone check), not by Step03, so they keep OoTR's branches.
_why.Hyrule Field / HF Ocarina of Time Item: OoTR's is_child and has_all_stones plus remake_zelda_escape_ready: the escape scene (HyruleField_Child_Prefab_0ce5) needs DoorOfTime exactly at Step03. Song from Ocarina of Time takes the same in songs_trade.json (its key lives there).
_why.Market Mask Shop Storefront / Mask of Tr: OoTR's event with remake_zelda_escape_ready added to its running-man part (at('Hyrule Field', is_child and has_all_stones and Bunny_Hood)): the running man reads DoorOfTime past Step03, so he appears only after the escape.

helpers.can_build_rainbow_bridge: ((bridge == 'open') or (bridge == 'vanilla' and 'Remake Light Arrow Cutscene' and Light_Arrows) or (bridge == 'stones' and has_stones(bridge_stones)) or (bridge == 'medallions' and has_medallions(bridge_medallions)) or (bridge == 'dungeons' and has_dungeon_rewards(bridge_rewards)) or (bridge == 'tokens' and (Gold_Skulltula_Token, bridge_tokens)) or (bridge == 'hearts' and has_hearts(bridge_hearts)))
helpers.can_ride_epona: is_adult and ((not no_epona_race and Epona) or (no_epona_race and at('Lon Lon Ranch', is_adult and can_play(Eponas_Song) and at_day))) and (can_play_ocarina(Eponas_Song) or (can_hover and not shuffle_overworld_entrances))
helpers.remake_zelda_escape_ready: skip_child_zelda or at('HC Garden Skippable Locations', is_child and Ocarina)
helpers.can_open_door_of_time: ( (open_door_of_time == 'open') or (open_door_of_time == 'sot' and can_play(Song_of_Time)) or (open_door_of_time == 'oot_sot' and (Ocarina, 2) and can_play(Song_of_Time)) or (open_door_of_time == 'stones' and has_all_stones) or (open_door_of_time == 'stones_sot' and has_all_stones and can_play(Song_of_Time)) or (open_door_of_time == 'stones_oot_sot' and has_all_stones and remake_zelda_escape_ready and (Ocarina, 2) and can_play(Song_of_Time)))

events.Mask of Truth Access: complete_mask_quest or (at('Kakariko Village', is_child and Keaton_Mask) and at('Lost Woods', is_child and can_play(Sarias_Song) and Skull_Mask) and at('Graveyard', is_child and at_day and Spooky_Mask) and at('Hyrule Field', is_child and has_all_stones and Bunny_Hood) and remake_zelda_escape_ready)
